results.question: What are the top 5 best-selling genres by total sales?
results.pred_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 5
results.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) as TotalSales FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: How many customers does each country have?
results.pred_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) AS NumberOfCustomers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country
results.gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) as CustomerCount FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC

results.question: Which employee has the most customers assigned to them?
results.pred_sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS EmployeeName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName as EmployeeName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) as CustomerCount FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the average invoice total for each country?
results.pred_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) AS AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry
results.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, AVG(Total) as AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AverageInvoiceTotal DESC

results.question: List all albums by the artist 'AC/DC'
results.pred_sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'
results.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

results.question: What are the names and email addresses of customers from Brazil?
results.pred_sql: SELECT Customer.FirstName || ' ' || Customer.LastName AS Name, Customer.Email FROM Customer WHERE Customer.Country = 'Brazil'
results.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

results.question: How many tracks are there in each playlist?
results.pred_sql: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name
results.gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) as TrackCount FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC

results.question: What is the total revenue generated in the year 2021?
results.pred_sql: SELECT SUM(Invoice.Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate) = '2021'
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) as TotalRevenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2021'

results.question: Which 5 tracks have the longest duration?
results.pred_sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5
results.gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What is the most popular media type based on number of tracks?
results.pred_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) as TrackCount FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1
